show_hn.title: Show HN: The Kio Programming Language
show_hn.story_text: Kio is a statically typed, hosted language that is designed to be ultra-portable. Kio 0.1 supports eight host languages and more will be added in the coming weeks. Kio is based on polymorphic lambda calculus with higher-kinded types. Kio has type-driven macros (elaborators) and it can statically check asserted equivalences using a normalizer. Kio is a minimalistic language. It doesn't have built-in effectful functions and it doesn't even have built-in string or numeric types. Instead programs declare the capabilities they need and the host supplies them. The language is designed with AI, which is bound to raise some eyebrows, so I blogged about that here: <a href="https://jdevuyst.github.io/kio/blog/2026-10-01-introducing-kio.html" rel="nofollow">https:&#

Show HN: Bun-install – Global CLI installer for Bun with local monorepo support
show_hn.story_text: Hey HN, This is a CLI tool I initially built as a convenient and reliable way to install executable(s) from a local monorepo workspace into Bun's global package store. I had a local monorepo with workspace dependencies that needed to be installed as a whole. The commands aren't bundled, and I didn't want to manually manage dependencies. (If you want to try it out, https://github.com/open-pencil/open-pencil is what I was contributing to) I tried `bun link` initially. But linking directly meant I had to keep a separate local checkout just so branch switches wouldn't break my installed tools. `bun-install` solves this by packaging the dependencies and installing

show_hn.title: Show HN: The Zoomist – looking and listening to ordinary things more closely
show_hn.story_text: I’ve been building a small project called The Zoomist. The idea is to take ordinary things that we normally see or hear without thinking about them, and change the scale or attention. Sometimes that means microscope or macro footage. Sometimes slow motion or extreme close-ups. Sometimes it’s simply recording an everyday sound very closely and listening to its texture. A piece of fabric, a fig, a fingernail, a toothbrush, an insect, running water, a motor - familiar things can become surprisingly unfamiliar when you get closer. I’m trying to keep the footage and sound as authentic as possible. I don’t want to turn everything into “science content” or generic ASMR, and when I’m not certain what I’m looking at under the microscope, I’d rather say that than make up an identification. Photograph of a solitary woman sitting peacefully on the edge of a high cliff, framed in a stark profile view against a sprawling twilight landscape. The composition positions her silhouette as a sharp, dark anchor on the right side of the frame, capturing her figure in quiet contemplation as she looks out over the horizon. She is perched safely back from the precipice, legs gently dangling over the side, her posture relaxed yet reflective. A very heavy, coarse film grain cuts across her solid black silhouette, giving the edges of her figure a raw, tactile texture that integrates her deeply into the moody atmosphere of the night. The color palette shifts beautifully from a soft, muted twilight sky into a sea of vibrant, blurred light. The sky above fades from a delicate, hazy lavender and pale orange into a deep, velvety violet along the horizon. Sprawled out below the cliffside is a vast city landscape completely transformed into a shimmering expanse of large, circular bokeh orbs. These distant city lights glow in a mesmerizing mix of warm amber, soft cream, pale green, and cool blue. A thick, heavy mist drifts between the valley and the cliff, partially swallowing the distant lights and diffusing their glow into a soft, ethereal wash that blankets the entire lower half of the composition. The photograph embraces a deeply artistic, low-fidelity analog aesthetic, heavily emulating a high-ISO film stock pushed to its absolute limits under low-light conditions. An extreme, shallow depth of field leaves the jagged rock face and the woman's silhouette in crisp, clear focus, while the entire world below dissolves into a beautifully soft, painterly blur.
